header: Questions teams ask before choosing Desiderio
subheadline: Answers on pricing, upgrades, custom elements, themes and accessibility.

items.question: Is Desiderio free?
items.answer: Yes. The Community plan costs €0 and is licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later. You get all 244 content elements, the full source on GitHub and community support. There is no licence key and no trial period. Paid plans add support and guarantees, not features.

items.question: What does Studio add for €590 a year?
items.answer: Studio costs €590 a year or €59 a month for up to 5 live sites. It adds the maintenance promise, 1 named developer and email answers within 2 business days. Agency costs €1,990 a year for up to 25 live sites. It adds answers by the next business day (CET), 3 named developers and a yearly onboarding call.

items.question: Can you upgrade our older TYPO3 sites?
items.answer: Yes. An upgrade audit costs €690 and ends with a fixed quote for the move to TYPO3 v14. If you book the upgrade, the €690 is credited to it.

items.question: What if we need a new element?
items.answer: We build custom content elements from €890 each. Each one gets a schema, template, backend preview and the same token-based theming as the other 244. It passes the audit and works with every preset. A Brand Theme puts your brand into a preset for €2,490.

items.question: Can I switch themes later without redoing content?
items.answer: Yes. The 15 presets only change design tokens and CSS, never stored content. You can switch the preset for the whole site or one part of it at any time. Every headline, image and link stays as entered.

items.question: Is Desiderio accessible?
items.answer: Desiderio gives you a good base: semantic markup, visible focus styles, alternative-text fields and tested contrast for every preset. Full WCAG 2.2 conformance depends on your content, configuration, extensions and testing with people. Automated checks catch structure and colour regressions, but they do not replace an audit of your site.
